summary.name: Keenable
summary.one_liner: Keenable is an independent web search API and index built for AI labs and agents, offering search and page fetch over API, CLI and MCP.
keywords: pay as you go search api

ground LLM answers in current web sources
fetch page content for agent pipelines
track changes or moves across web pages over time
compare search providers on cost and quality
run web search from a command line or MCP client
summary.what_it_does: Keenable describes itself as independent web search infrastructure with its own crawler, index and ranking, and says it improves as more agents use it. The page claims an index of 100B+ documents with under 250ms p95 latency (US East) and pricing from $1 per 1K requests at 100+ RPS. It offers a Search API for agents, with pay-as-you-go access at $4 per 1,000 requests (cloud-only) and a Frontier tier at $1 per 1,000 requests for AI labs and inference platforms (cloud or on-premises). The page also describes a Web Query Language that runs SQL-style queries over web search results with semantic extraction and per-row source URLs, and a Time Machine feature for searching historical snapshots of web pages via a query_time parameter. A listing elsewhere mentions search and page fetch over API, CLI and MCP, 100K free requests a month and keyless public endpoints; those details are not on the page text itself.
notable: Own crawler, index and ranking rather than reselling another provider's results
Time Machine: point-in-time search over historical snapshots of web pages
Web Query Language for SQL-style queries over search results with source URLs per row
Claims an independent index of 100B+ documents with sub-250ms p95 latency
caveats: Agent Builder tier is cloud-only; on-premises deployment is only in the Frontier tier
Performance and quality figures are company-reported benchmarks
Frontier tier targets AI labs and inference platforms with dedicated capacity
